lines.text: They have beef over a game.

example.text: They have beef over a game.

misuse.text: Don't say 'we have beef' about a small mix-up.
misuse.why: It sounds like a serious feud.

data.l1_hook: वो दोनों बात करना बंद कर गए। क्यों? beef?
data.l1_ex: उनके बीच खेल को लेकर beef है।

native.tip: “beef” = अनबन; दुश्मनी; झगड़ा. उदाहरण: “They have beef over a game.”
